senses.gloss: m. ch. = h.יֶתֶר I , 1, strong cord, esp.

units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 42a:1">Snh. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>למיהוי כי י׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="J00739"><he>יְתֵירָא</he></cite>) until the shape of the moon is like that of the cord (with the bent bow, semicircular).—Pl. (<he>יְתֵירֵי</he>) <he>יִתְיֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 26a:10">M. Kat. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>לקל י׳ דמזיגת וכ׳</he> from the sound of the cords (of the catapults) at M. (v. <cite ref="M00154"><he>מְגִיזָה</he></cite>) the wall of Laodicea burst.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 16:7">Targ. Jud. XVI, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 16:8">8</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 16:9">9</cite>.

senses.gloss: the straight side of the stomach, opp. to קשתא the curved side, v. הִימְצָא.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 51a:9">Pes. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>אכל דאיי׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="D00453"><he>דיי׳</he></cite>) ate the fat &c.—[<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 25:20">Targ. Prov. XXV, 20</cite> <he>יתרא</he> Ms. (Var. ed. Lag.), ed. <cite ref="N01396"><he>נִתְרָא</he></cite>.]
